chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Know that a dark-skinned woman, if she bears many children, is more beloved to me than a beautiful woman who is barren.

key_terms.أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ: More beloved to me; more preferable in this context
key_terms.الْعَاقِرِ: Barren; one who does not bear children
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةَ: The woman; the subject under discussion
key_terms.اِعْلَمُوا: Know; an imperative calling the audience to pay attention
key_terms.وَلُودًا: One who bears many children; fertile

ai.seo_question: Why is a fertile woman preferred over a merely beautiful but barren woman in this hadith?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام states a preference for fertility and childbearing over mere physical beauty in choosing a wife. The saying emphasizes practical and family-centered qualities above outward appearance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Know that a dark-skinned woman who bears many children is more beloved to me than a beautiful woman who is barren."
